title: JPEG XL DC preview

definition.title: JPEG XL DC preview
definition.source_excerpt: A 1024×768 JPEG XL image (29,564 bytes) was decoded directly through libjxl's progressive API. At the first FRAME_PROGRESSION event, FlushImage produced the 1:8 intended-downsampling-ratio DC image after only 6,926 bytes had been consumed—23.43% of the codestream. The flushed preview measured 22.09 dB PSNR against the final decoded image. A separate cancellation run destroyed the decoder at that exact progression point and consumed no later codestream bytes. Completing the decode yielded RGB bytes identical to FFmpeg's libjxl output. The result is an actual codec-progressive preview, not a truncated-file heuristic. It is intentionally a lower-fidelity preview and must be labeled as such.
